anon.title: House Rules
paragraphs: Please remove shoes indoors per traditional Korean customs
No smoking allowed inside the property
Dispose of toilet paper only in the toilet
Cooking strongly odorous foods is prohibited

anon.title: Garbage Disposal
paragraphs: Please separate waste into general waste, food waste, and recycling.
Trash collection days: Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday.
General Waste
Burnable waste — use designated pay-as-you-throw bags.
Paper, disposable chopsticks, tissues, masks
Food Waste
Squeeze out excess moisture before disposing in designated food waste bags.
Food waste: fruits, vegetables, rice, leftovers, meat
NOT food waste: bones, seashells, tea leaves, nutshells, eggshells, onion skins
Recyclable Waste
Place recyclable items into white bags.
Plastics, vinyl, glass bottles, metals
Paper items (boxes, newspapers) — flatten before disposal
If you're unsure how to separate the waste, feel free to ask for assistance.

anon.title: Heating System
paragraphs: When you turn on the power, an orange light will illuminate and the temperature will be displayed.
Power On/Off
Press the [전원] (Power) button at the bottom left. The display will light up.
Floor Heating (Ondol)
Press the [온돌] button. Turn the center dial to set your desired temperature.
Recommended: 45°C ~ 55°C for a cozy floor.
It takes some time for the heat to rise through the floor.
In summer, please use the "외출" (Away) mode.
Hot Water (Shower)
Press the [온수] button. Turn the center dial to adjust temperature:
저 (Low) / 중 (Mid) / 고 (High)
Make sure the 온수 icon appears on the screen before using the water.

anon.title: Air Conditioner
paragraphs: Use the power button to turn on/off
If cool air is not coming out, press the "모드" (Mode) button and switch to "냉방" (Cooling)
Adjust the temperature using the "온도" (Temperature) switch

anon.title: Induction Stove
paragraphs: The right burner is for large pans (19cm or larger). For smaller pans, use the left burner.
Controls
① Power Level / Timer — adjusts heat and sets timer
② Burner Selection — selects the desired burner
③ Child Lock — prevents operation by children
④ Pause — temporarily stops the burner
⑤ Timer — countdown to auto turn-off
⑥ Turbo — high heat mode (hold 3s for boost)
⑦ Power — turns stove on/off

unwadang.title: House Rules
paragraphs: 1. Please take off your shoes indoors
In accordance with traditional Korean etiquette, please take off your shoes indoors.
2. No smoking allowed
For a pleasant environment, smoking is prohibited inside the accommodation. We ask for your cooperation for everyone's health and cleanliness.

unwadang.title: Bluetooth Speaker
paragraphs: The Bluetooth speaker available in your room is the HK Aura Studio 3.
How to connect
Turn on Bluetooth on your phone or device
Look for HK Aura Studio 3 in the device list
Tap to pair and play your favorite music
Please keep the volume considerate of neighbors during quiet hours.

unwadang.title: Washing Machine
paragraphs: Detergent is located under the sink.
① Power Button
Turns the washer on/off
Auto-off after 10 minutes of no use
Press Pause/Start before powering off during a cycle
② Course / Add Function Button
Select wash programs
Press again to adjust temperature, rinse, spin, or extra features
Hold for 3 seconds to cancel added functions
③ Dial Knob
Turn to browse options
Press to confirm or activate selections on the screen
④ Pause / Start Button
Starts or pauses the wash cycle
Must press to resume after pause

unwadang.title: Waste Disposal
paragraphs: Please separate waste into general waste, food waste, and recycling.
Trash collection days: Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday.
If you're unsure how to separate the waste, feel free to ask for assistance.
General Waste
Burnable waste — use designated pay-as-you-throw bags
All items that are not food waste
Examples: paper, disposable chopsticks, tissues, masks
Food Waste
Squeeze out excess moisture before disposing in food waste bags
Examples: fruits, vegetables, rice, leftovers, meat
NOT food waste: bones, seashells, tea leaves, nutshells, eggshells, onion skins
Recyclable Waste
Place recyclable items into white bags
Examples: plastics, vinyl, glass bottles, metals
For paper items (boxes, newspapers, books) — flatten neatly before disposal

unwadang.title: Boiler (Winter Heating)
paragraphs: The boiler thermostat is located in front of the bathroom.
Hot water indicator
The light on the faucet-shaped icon indicates hot water. If it turns off, hot water will not come out — always keep it on!
Temperature control
The temperature button is on the left side
If the house-shaped light is on, the thermostat is active
Adjust temperature using + / −
The set temperature is displayed at the top
Recommended: 20–23°C for a comfortable room.

unwadang.title: Air Conditioner
paragraphs: The air conditioner is operated via remote control.
① Turn on
Press the power button (10) on the remote control.
② Set mode to Cooling
Press [ 모드 ] (16). Each press changes the mode. Press repeatedly until "냉방" (Cooling) is shown on the remote's screen.
③ Set temperature
Use [ 온도 +/− ] (11) to set the desired temperature.
Recommended: 22–24°C.
④ Adjust fan speed
Use [ 바람 ] (17) — Low / Medium / High.

unwadang.title: Water Purifier
paragraphs: The water purifier in the kitchen provides hot, cold, and purified water.
Controls
① Dispense Lever — push to dispense water
④ Purified Water — room temperature
⑤ Hot Water (red light) — for tea, ramen, etc.
⑥ Cold Water (blue light) — chilled drinking water
⑦ Water Volume Control — adjusts how much pours out
Please be careful — hot water can scald.

paragraphs: 전원을 켜면 주황색 불이 들어오고 현재 온도가 표시됩니다.
전원 ON/OFF
좌측 하단의 [전원] 버튼을 누르시면 화면이 켜집니다.
온돌 (바닥 난방)
[온돌] 버튼을 누르고 가운데 다이얼을 돌려 희망 온도를 설정하세요.
권장 온도: 45°C ~ 55°C
바닥까지 열이 전달되기까지 시간이 조금 걸립니다.
여름철에는 "외출" 모드를 사용해 주세요.
온수 (샤워)
[온수] 버튼을 누르고 가운데 다이얼로 온도를 조절하세요:
저 / 중 / 고
화면에 "온수" 아이콘이 표시된 것을 확인하고 사용해 주세요.

anon.title: 에어컨

anon.title: ごみの分別
paragraphs: 一般ごみ・生ごみ・リサイクル品に分別してください。
収集日: 火曜・木曜・日曜
一般ごみ
指定の従量制袋をご使用ください。
紙、割り箸、ティッシュ、マスクなど
生ごみ
水気をよく切って、専用袋に入れてください。
生ごみ対象: 果物、野菜、ごはん、残飯、肉類
生ごみではないもの: 骨、貝殻、茶葉、ナッツの殻、卵の殻、玉ねぎの皮
リサイクル品
白い透明袋に入れてください。
プラスチック、ビニール、ガラス瓶、金属類
紙類(段ボール、新聞)— 折りたたんでから廃棄
分別にご不明な点があればお気軽にご連絡ください。

paragraphs: 電源を入れるとオレンジ色のランプが点灯し、現在の温度が表示されます。
電源 ON/OFF

オンドル(床暖房)

床が温まるまで少し時間がかかります。
夏場は「외출」(外出)モードをご使用ください。
お湯(シャワー)
[온수] ボタンを押し、中央のダイヤルで温度調整:
저(低) / 중(中) / 고(高)
画面に「온수」アイコンが表示されていることを確認してからご使用ください。

anon.title: 垃圾分类
paragraphs: 请将垃圾分为一般垃圾、厨余垃圾和可回收物。
清运日: 周二、周四、周日
一般垃圾
请使用指定的按量收费垃圾袋。
纸类、一次性筷子、纸巾、口罩等
厨余垃圾
请沥干水分后投入厨余专用袋。
属于厨余: 水果、蔬菜、米饭、剩菜、肉类
不属于厨余: 骨头、贝壳、茶叶、坚果壳、蛋壳、洋葱皮

如对分类有疑问,请随时与我们联系。

夏季请使用"외출"(外出)模式。
热水(淋浴)
按 [온수] 键,旋转中央旋钮调节温度:
저(低) / 중(中) / 고(高)
请确认屏幕上出现"온수"图标后再使用。

anon.title: 空调
paragraphs: 用 电源键 开关
若无冷风,请按 "모드"(模式) 切换至 "냉방"(制冷)
用 "온도"(温度) 开关调节温度

anon.title: 电磁炉
paragraphs: 右炉为大锅(直径19cm以上)专用,小锅请使用左炉。
操作按钮
① 火力 / 定时 — 调节火力与设定定时
② 炉口选择 — 选择所用炉口
③ 童锁 — 防止误操作
④ 暂停 — 暂时停止
⑤ 定时 — 自动关闭倒计时
⑥ 强火 — 高火模式(长按3秒)
⑦ 电源 — 整体 ON/OFF

一般垃圾

纸类、一次性筷子、纸巾、口罩等
厨余垃圾
请沥干水分后投入厨余专用袋。
属于厨余: 水果、蔬菜、米饭、剩菜、肉类

可回收物
